ongoingGame.junglePathing.title: Jungle
ongoingGame.junglePathing.noCurrentChamp: No jungle samples for current champion
ongoingGame.junglePathing.mapSemanticDes: Dots are minute-frame position samples from the first 14 minutes. Crosses are takedown-participation positions within 14 minutes. Mini-map points may be sampled; use Zone Weight for exact values.
ongoingGame.junglePathing.algorithmSumma: Zone Weight measures top / mid / bot activity intensity during the first 14 minutes.
First clear and early ganks are aggregated within the current sample scope and split by blue / red side.
ongoingGame.junglePathing.algorithmDetai: {zoneWeight} = Σ {positionWeight} + Σ {takedownWeight}. {positionWeight}: during the {first14Minutes}, each minute-frame adds {pointOne} to the jungler's current top / mid / bot zone. {takedownWeight}: each takedown participation within 14 minutes adds {pointFive} to the takedown-position zone.

{preferenceDecision}: mid + bot share ≥ 70% and top share ≤ 28% means {midBot}. Top + mid share ≥ 70% and bot share ≤ 28% means {topMid}. {singleZone} share ≥ 40% and at least 8 percentage points ahead of the second-highest zone means Top / Mid / Bot. Otherwise {balanced}.
{firstClearDecision}: use the nearest jungle camp to the {oneMinutePosition}. If the camp is in the enemy half, it is counted as an {invadeStart}.

{level3Decision}: at the {threeMinuteFrame}, CS (minion + jungle) is {csRange}, level is {level3}, and {championDamage} is detected. Without detailed damage data, {takedownParticipation} within 3 minutes is used as the damage condition.

{level4Decision}: by the {fourMinuteFrame}, {championDamageIncrease} is detected compared with the 3-minute frame, or {takedownParticipation} occurred from 3-4 minutes. Without detailed damage data, only {takedownParticipation} is used.
{aggregation}: the active tab defines the {sampleScope} (current champion or all). First clear / early ganks are accumulated separately for {blueRedSide}.

legal.declaration.newContent:
# LeagueAkari-MyGo

LeagueAkari-MyGo is a League of Legends match-history and champion-selection assistant for Tencent servers, built from League Akari under the MIT license.

It connects to the signed-in League Client and reads match history and owned skins. Automatic actions are controlled in settings and disabled by default.

Client and server APIs may change. Credentials stay in memory and authentication tokens are excluded from logs.

The upstream copyright and license are included in LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

When locked, League Akari makes the League settings file read-only. The game can still read your current settings, but new changes will not be saved over them.
Unlocking restores write access, so graphics, hotkeys, and other in-game changes save normally again.
